# Mod list

Every mod on this page has a published release on GitHub. A script builds the page from each mod's repository, so the name, description and supported game builds are the ones in the manifest at that release. To install a mod, open **Mods** in the game and choose **Recommended mods...**. A mod that is not on that screen installs by its repository address, from **Get a mod another way...**.

## First-party mods

Mods by the maintainer of Neo Angband. Report a bug in what a mod does in that mod's own repository.

### Quality of Life

Conveniences that faithful Angband does not have. Angband's own options belong to core, and this mod leaves them alone.

Looking for zoom, hover cards or the high-contrast and colourblind displays? Those visual features, along with the other display options, now live in the AnybandUI mod.

Enable it and you get the whole set, and each tweak has its own toggle you can switch off separately. Turn the mod off and the base game is exactly as it was.

- Mod id: `qol`, by neostryder
- Newest release: [v1.13.0](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-qol/releases/tag/v1.13.0), published 2026-09-27
- Game builds: `>=1.8.0`
- In the game: **Recommended mods...**
- Links: [repository](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-qol), [docs](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-qol/blob/v1.13.0/docs/README.md)

### Bug Fixes

Opt-in fixes for bugs in Angband 4.2.6, in the style of an unofficial patch.

Each kind of fix has its own toggle, so you can switch off any one of them and keep the rest. The port itself reproduces 4.2.6 faithfully, bugs included, so with this mod off none of these fixes apply.

- Mod id: `bug-fixes`, by neostryder
- Newest release: [v1.3.0](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-bug-fixes/releases/tag/v1.3.0), published 2026-09-26
- Game builds: `>=1.2.0`
- In the game: **Recommended mods...**
- Links: [repository](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-bug-fixes), [docs](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-bug-fixes/blob/v1.3.0/docs/README.md)

### Linoleum

An alternative tile engine that makes a tile set much easier to build: a folder of individual PNGs named after what they draw, instead of one sheet plus a table of pixel coordinates.

Enabling it adds six rows to the Graphics screen with Angband's own tile sets converted to this format, so you can compare both engines on the same art. The game's own graphics are core content and stay untouched when this is off.

Unlike a fixed sheet, it can have one symbol draw from a pool of variants, picked by map position so a seed still replays identically. Build your own pack with the converter in the main repository, or by hand; the format is plain text plus PNGs (docs/LINOLEUM.md).

Converting somebody's tile set modifies their art. The Shockbolt packs ship under permission granted to Neo Angband specifically, on condition that this project does not profit, so check a set's licence before sharing a pack you built from it.

- Mod id: `linoleum`, by neostryder
- Newest release: [v1.5.0](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-linoleum/releases/tag/v1.5.0), published 2026-10-02
- Game builds: `>=1.21.1`
- In the game: **Recommended mods...**
- Links: [repository](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-linoleum), [docs](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-linoleum/blob/v1.5.0/docs/README.md)

### Borg

Angband's automatic player, ported from the borg in Angband 4.2.6. It plays through the same commands you use, over the frozen agent API, so it is an ordinary mod with no privileged code inside the engine.

Installing and enabling it does not give it your character. Press Ctrl-Z in play to hand over the keyboard; it warns you and asks you to confirm first. It is deterministic and draws only on its own seeded random number generator, so your save is not flagged as non-reproducible. Only one autoplayer can hold the keyboard at a time.

- Mod id: `borg`, by neostryder
- Newest release: [v1.3.0](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-borg/releases/tag/v1.3.0), published 2026-10-02
- Game builds: `>=1.21.1`
- In the game: **Recommended mods...**
- Links: [repository](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-borg), [docs](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-borg/blob/v1.3.0/docs/README.md)

### Cutting Room Floor

Brings back Angband features that later versions dropped, and content upstream wrote but never switched on, as opt-in content. The base game stays faithful to Angband 4.2.6: nothing changes unless you switch a toggle on, and every toggle defaults to off.

Each one has its own toggle, so you can pick just the ones you want.

- Mod id: `feature-restoration`, by neostryder
- Newest release: [v1.3.0](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-feature-restoration/releases/tag/v1.3.0), published 2026-10-02
- Game builds: `>=1.21.1`
- In the game: **Recommended mods...**
- Links: [repository](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-feature-restoration), [docs](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-feature-restoration/blob/v1.3.0/docs/README.md)

### ModForge

Make your own mod from inside the game. Start from something that already exists, such as a monster, a sword, a shop or a spell, and the workshop shows you what it is made of, how each of its numbers compares with similar things in the game, and what you would need to change to get the thing you have in mind. When you are happy with it, one button forges the mod, loads it for this session and reloads the game so you are playing it. You can also save it as a file to give to someone else.

You do not have to know JSON to use it. If you want to see it, every screen can show you the exact file it is about to write, and a mod it built can be taken away, edited by hand and brought back.

The workshop tab appears in the corner of the screen. Tap it to open the workshop.

- Mod id: `forge`, by neostryder
- Newest release: [v1.4.2](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-forge/releases/tag/v1.4.2), published 2026-09-26
- Game builds: `>=1.0.0`
- In the game: **Recommended mods...**
- Links: [repository](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-forge), [docs](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-forge/blob/v1.4.2/docs/README.md)

### Upstream Catchup

Opt-in changes from upstream Angband development after 4.2.6, the tag this port is pinned to. Each kind of change has its own toggle and cites the upstream commit that made it. With everything off, core stays exactly 4.2.6.

Once core rebaselines onto a newer upstream tag, everything here is already in the game and the mod deletes itself.

- Mod id: `upstream-catchup`, by neostryder
- Newest release: [v1.2.0](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-upstream-catchup/releases/tag/v1.2.0), published 2026-09-26
- Game builds: `>=1.18.0`
- In the game: **Recommended mods...**
- Links: [repository](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-upstream-catchup), [docs](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-upstream-catchup/blob/v1.2.0/docs/README.md)

### AnybandUI

Wurli Monkhaven's AnybandUI, rebuilt for Neo Angband. You can play with the mouse: click the map to move and act, keep your character, status and messages in panels, and compare gear in an item window before you wear it. Each feature has its own switch and starts off, and none of them change the game's rules.

- Mod id: `anybandui`, by WurliMonkhaven, neostryder
- Newest release: [v1.1.0](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-anybandui/releases/tag/v1.1.0), published 2026-10-02

### Squire

A learning Angband autoplayer. Press Ctrl-Z and Squire plays your character: it fights, casts spells, uses its items, shops in town and goes deeper, asking a model (Jev, or Laya on your own computer) what to do each time something changes. Press any key to take the keyboard back.

While you play, Squire watches as your apprentice and notes where its choices differ from yours. Give it a persona and it plays in character. Each run ends with a report you can save and share.

With no model set up, Squire keeps playing by its own rules until you take the keyboard back or the character dies. You can also choose a short errand: clear what is in front of you, or explore the floor. It sees only what you could see and plays by the game's rules. A character handed to any autoplayer is marked, and the game keeps it off the score table.

- Mod id: `squire`, by neostryder
- Newest release: [v0.2.0](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-squire/releases/tag/v0.2.0) (marked as a pre-release), published 2026-10-02
- Game builds: `>=1.21.1`
- In the game: install it by repository address
- Links: [repository](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-squire), [docs](https://github.com/neostryder/neo-angband-mod-squire/blob/v0.2.0/docs/README.md)
